title: A large-scale analysis of public-facing, community-built chatbots on Character.AI

bias_targets.methodology: Extracting identifying phrases for users versus characters from chatbot greetings using dependency parsing, projecting these phrases onto a gender dimension ('man' vs 'woman') using word embeddings, and calculating weighted log-odds to test for gender stereotypes.

Extracting descriptive phrases for users versus characters using dependency parsing, projecting these phrases onto a power dimension ('weak' vs 'strong') using word embeddings, and conducting statistical tests to evaluate power dynamics and representations of submission versus dominance.
